The '''Nek language''' is a language spoken by the Nek people in the [[Morobe Province]] of [[Papua New Guinea]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-01-12 |title=Nek Language |url=https://nektokmedia.com/en |access-date=2024-10-18 |website=nektokmedia.com |language=en}}</ref> The Nek language has two dialects, eastern and western<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-02-15 |title=About us {{!}} Nek Language |url=https://nektokmedia.com/en/about-us |access-date=2024-10-18 |website=nektokmedia.com |language=en}}</ref> and it is a [[Finisterre languages|Finisterre language]].
